problem_text:
A shipping coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package 1: size 44 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 30 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 39 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 43 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 66 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 30 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 38 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 39 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 61 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 64 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 32 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 62 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 50 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 44 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 41 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 59 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 50 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 58 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 44 cubic feet
* Package 21: size 70 cubic feet
* Package 22: size 47 cubic feet
* Package 23: size 42 cubic feet
* Package 24: size 36 cubic feet
* Package 25: size 52 cubic feet
* Package 26: size 61 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 cubic feet. Load all packages using the fewest trucks. Each package must be placed in exactly one truck, and the total volume in a truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
